description: Frozen lexical cue list for Phase 5A cue gating (PLAN.md section 8A.1). Derived from the actual command text of the spatial and multi_hop rows in data/benchmark/synthetic_500.jsonl, not invented from intuition. A command containing none of these (case-insensitive substring match) is resolved against the v1 single-field grammar with the hop suppressed. Frozen before any accuracy measurement; do not edit based on downstream results without recording a deviation.
